about: Own-words reads from the daily research task (ADMIS, Rabobank, Czapp and the news feed). fund_score: -1 bearish to +1 bullish, a judgement on the fundamental news only.

corn.fundamental: Dec is slightly firmer at ~450 but has slipped back under the 451 level after the early test of 453; the lagging harvest and firm Mexican demand are known, and soybeans weakening into harvest-end limits follow-through.
events: Dec corn ~450 (+1.25), range 447.75-453 (CBOT via TradingView)
Corn tests resistance early, then fades (Pro Farmer)
Wheat and corn rise while soybeans slip near harvest-end (Reuters)

soybeans.fundamental: Beans are flat (~1230 Jan) as harvest nears completion and the market waits on Trump's Asia talks for any China tariff change; the record crush has not been enough to lift price.
events: Jan soybeans ~1230.5 (+1.5), range 1224.5-1237.75 (CBOT via TradingView)
Soybeans ease as US harvest nears completion (Reuters)
Trump's Asia talks keep China soybean trade in focus (AgroLatam)

meal.fundamental: Meal extends gains (Dec ~337.5, +2.9) toward 336-337 resistance as the oil-share shift continues to favour meal in the crush.
events: Dec meal ~337.5 (+2.9), high 339.8 (CBOT via TradingView)
Record NOPA crush driven by oil weakness (Barchart)

oil.fundamental: Soyoil fell ~2.5% with crude down 4%, which cuts biofuel margins. Chevron restarting an Iowa biodiesel plant on demand is a small offset.
events: Jan soyoil -1.57 to ~62.48, tracking crude lower (CBOT via TradingView)
Chevron to restart an Iowa biodiesel plant (Farm Progress)
IEA sees a global oil surplus in Q4 (ADMIS)

wheat.fundamental: Chicago is up ~10 to ~597.5 after reclaiming 590, led by a sharp HRW rally; with no new supply shock in the feed, it looks like fund short covering after Monday's Black Sea-driven drop, while improving US winter wheat ratings still point to easier supply.
events: Dec Chicago wheat ~597.5 (+10.5), range 585-600.25 (CBOT via TradingView)
KC leads with a 17-cent jump (CBOT via TradingView)
Wheat and corn rise as soybeans slip (Reuters)

kc.fundamental: HRW is leading the grain complex, Dec up ~17 to ~636 and through the 629.5 and 634.75 resistance levels at the day's high. No new crop scare in the news flow, so this reads as short covering in a heavily sold market; Plains ratings are still improving, which limits the fundamental case.
events: Dec KC wheat ~636 (+17), range 617.75-636, through 629.5/634.75 resistance (CBOT via TradingView)
Nebraska growers shift failed corn acres to wheat (Brownfield)
Winter wheat condition up again (USDA via Farm Progress)

cotton.fundamental: Dec has pushed back above the broken 77.05 level to ~77.6 (+0.62) with Mar ~81.65, helped by a slightly softer dollar (DXY ~103.4). It is a short-covering bounce rather than new supply news; into Dec first notice, high-grade certs remain a risk for old-crop longs, so 79.90 resistance is the level to prove the low is in.
events: Dec cotton ~77.62 (+0.62), range 76.82-77.70; Mar ~81.65 (ICE via TradingView)
Dollar index eases to ~103.4 (ICE via TradingView)

hogs.fundamental: Dec hogs drop ~1.4 to ~53.9, near the 53.18 support, as packers' positive margins have not translated into firmer cash and producers face a down market into winter; PRRS pressure adds to the nervousness.
events: Dec lean hogs ~53.93 (-1.43), low 53.68 (CME via TradingView)
Lean hogs fall while pork processors stay profitable (The Pig Site)
Producers brace for a down market (National Hog Farmer)

cattle.fundamental: Live cattle ease (Dec ~219, -1.3) after the processor-led rally; Tyson's Allied Beef deal and USDA's slaughter-capacity loans are long-term demand positives for cattle, while screwworm spread in the Southwest keeps the Mexican feeder border shut and supply tight.
events: Dec live cattle ~219.0 (-1.33) (CME via TradingView)
Tyson expands Texas beef capacity via Allied Beef deal (Brownfield)
USDA loans aim to expand beef slaughter capacity (Farm Progress)

feeders.fundamental: Jan feeders fall ~3.8 to ~329.3, below the 120-day momentum trigger near 332 and toward 328.85 support; the slide follows live cattle, even as harvest-end feedlot demand and the closed Mexican border remain supportive.
events: Jan feeders ~329.3 (-3.78), low 329.1 (CME via TradingView)
Feeder demand expected to pick up as harvest ends (ADMIS)
Screwworm cases top 100 across TX, NM and AZ (Drovers)

events: HPAI returns to Oklahoma dairy herds after two years (Dairy Herd)
More cheese and whey output weighs on milk prices (Farm Progress)
CME spot mixed, butter +2 cents (Brownfield)

class4.fundamental: Butter firmed on the spot market while NDM fell; HPAI in new herds is a small supply risk.
events: Butter +2 cents on CME spot Monday (Brownfield)

events: Dec WTI ~86.22 (+0.50), range 84.68-87.38 (NYMEX via TradingView)
Iraq resumes crude exports via the Turkey pipeline (Reuters)
Glut fears outweigh Hormuz tanker attacks (OilPrice)

events: Dec ULSD ~4.049 (-0.032) (NYMEX via TradingView)
Iraq pipeline restart weighs on crude (Reuters)
